fields.description: BRD D.3 -- 12 Nov 2026 rebuild: one Inquiry now genuinely holds every item the dealer asked about together, as real child rows (Inquiry Item), matching how Sales Order/Quotation already hold their own lines -- not the old one-Inquiry-per-item-plus-shared-request_group workaround. At least one row required; see sales.inquiry_api._create_inquiry for the exactly-one-of-item/custom_requested_style rule enforced per row.
fields.label: Items

fields.description: Which of the dealer's own sales staff phoned this in -- a dealer can have several people inquiring about different items at once (client requirement 8.9). Free text, not a link: this app has no separate dealer-contacts master.
fields.label: Contact Name

fields.description: BRD D.3 -- 12 Nov 2026 rebuild: workflow stage only now. Per-item stock availability (Available/Partially Available/Out of Stock/Pre-order Required) moved to each row's own Inquiry Item.availability_status, since one Inquiry's items can genuinely be in different stock positions at once -- something a single Inquiry-level field could never represent correctly once an Inquiry could hold more than one item.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Open
Quoted
Converted to Order
Rejected
Mapped to PO
Closed

fields.description: Client request, 28 Oct 2026 -- the dealer portal's own "Ask for quotation" button on an enquiry still waiting on one (dealer_portal_api.request_quotation). Distinct from follow_up_date, which staff set for their own planning; this is the dealer actively asking. Never cleared automatically -- status moving to Quoted/Converted/Rejected/Closed is what the portal checks to stop offering the button again, not this flag.
fields.label: Dealer Requested Quote

fields.description: BRD C.3.1/C.13.1 — closes the inquiry when the dealer (or staff, on their behalf) converts it straight to an order. Set once, at conversion; the dealer portal's own convert_to_order is the normal path that sets it.
fields.label: Customer PO Number
Drop Reason
fields.description: BRD C.2.3 -- why an inquiry was closed or rejected without becoming an order. One of DMS Sales Settings' Inquiry Drop Reasons.

fields.label: Drop Reason Details
fields.description: Free text, required when the drop reason is Other.

BRD D.3 — set once, at the same moment status moves to "Converted to Order" (sales.order_api._create_order), so the conversion is traceable from the Inquiry side rather than only discoverable by searching the Sales Order for a matching custom_source_ref. 12 Nov 2026 rebuild: one Inquiry now converts to exactly one combined, multi-line Sales Order, so this single field is the complete record of it -- no longer one-per-item.
fields.label: Linked Sales Order

fields.description: Set once, at the same moment status moves to "Quoted" (sales.quotation_api.create_quotation). 12 Nov 2026 rebuild: one Inquiry now converts to exactly one combined, multi-line Quotation, so this single field is the complete record of it -- no longer one-per-item, and no longer several inquiries merging into one quotation (each Inquiry already holds every item it needs to).
fields.label: Linked Quotation

fields.description: Set once, at creation (sales.inquiry_api._mirror_to_opportunity) — the native ERPNext Opportunity this Inquiry was mirrored into, so desk staff have one list to work from instead of a separate Inquiry list. One-way, create-time only; later status changes on this Inquiry are not pushed to the Opportunity.
fields.label: Linked Opportunity
